requirements.ruleText: Be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China and be in good mental and physical health.
Hold a master's degree and be under 40 years old.
Submit an HSK Level 5 score of at least 180 issued within two years; applicants whose previous education at a Chinese university was taught in Chinese may use the published exemption.
Apply online from November 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026; scholarship routes may use separate deadlines.
Register in September 2026 on the specific date published in the admission notice.
Apply through the Beihang international-student online application system and upload every required document.
Upload the Doctoral Program application form generated by the online system.
Upload the ordinary-passport information page; the passport must remain valid beyond September 2026.
Upload a notarized highest diploma; expected graduates may submit official student-status evidence showing the expected graduation date.
Upload sealed academic transcripts covering study from the undergraduate stage onward.
Submit the Beihang supervisor acceptance letter.
Submit a study plan written in Chinese or English containing more than 1,000 characters or words using the published form.
Submit two Chinese- or English-language recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, including a comprehensive evaluation.
Submit a complete Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid for six months with the required final opinion, physician signature, hospital stamp and sealed photograph.
Submit a valid no-criminal-record certificate issued by the local public-security authority, normally within six months before application.
Submit the applicant's financial-guarantor certificate and bank statement using the published template.
Submit a résumé giving a chronological account of academic or professional experience from senior high school to the present.
Submit the integrity commitment letter using the published template.
Upload proof of application-fee payment showing the applicant's name and passport information.
Submit the published list-of-application-documents template and any other document Beihang requires.
Use Chinese or English documents or attach notarized Chinese or English translations, and ensure every uploaded record is clear, authentic and valid. Hard copies are not required for application.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee; document review begins only after the payment receipt is submitted.

references.locator: Required Documents notice and Fees section

requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of CNY 42,000.
Pay CNY 800 per year for comprehensive medical and accident insurance and purchase it at registration.

Apply for a double-room bed in advance. Published rates are CNY 30 per day per bed at Beijing campuses and CNY 2,000 per year per bed at the Hangzhou International Campus, excluding utilities and subject to actual assignment.
Review the separately published Chinese Government, Beijing Government and Beihang foreign-student scholarship routes and their own deadlines.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen.
Maintain a friendly attitude toward China, have no criminal record, and comply with Chinese laws and regulations and the university's rules.
Be in good physical and mental health and demonstrate strong academic performance and conduct.
Be committed to working in Chinese-language education, teaching, or a related field.
Be 16 to 35 years old as of September 1, 2026. The upper age limit is 45 for in-service Chinese-language teachers.

requirements.ruleText: Provide an HSK Level 3 score of at least 180 and an HSKK score.

references.locator: Section II, One-Semester Study Program, first track

requirements.appliesTo: Traditional Chinese Medicine or Taiji Culture applicants
requirements.ruleText: Provide an HSK score. Applicants who also provide an HSKK score receive priority.

references.locator: Section II, One-Semester Study Program, second track

requirements.ruleText: Apply through the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship section of the CLEC website, select Beihang University as the host institution, submit the application materials online, and track the review and final result in the system.
Submit the student application by October 31, 2026 Beijing Time.
Submit a scanned copy of the passport photo page.

references.locator: Section VI, List of Application Materials, item 1

requirements.ruleText: Submit scanned HSK and HSKK score reports. The score reports are valid for two years.

references.locator: Section VI, List of Application Materials, item 2

requirements.ruleText: Submit a recommendation letter from the head of the recommending institution.

references.locator: Section VI, List of Application Materials, item 3

requirements.ruleText: Submit proof of employment and a recommendation letter issued by the employer.

references.locator: Section VI, List of Application Materials, item 4

requirements.ruleText: Submit entrusted-guardianship documents signed by a guardian in China.

references.locator: Section VI, List of Application Materials, item 5

requirements.ruleText: Attend the interview held by Beihang University and provide any additional proof materials it requires.

references.locator: Section VI, List of Application Materials, item 6

requirements.ruleText: Normally, applicants who received a similar scholarship within the previous three years are not admitted to the one-semester program.

Pass the pre-enrollment medical examination, confirm enrollment with Beihang, and register by the date in the admission letter. Scholarship eligibility may be revoked for failing the examination, withdrawing early, registering late without permission, or suspending study.

references.locator: Sections III and V, enrollment and scholarship-revocation rules

sources.title: 北京航空航天大学 2026 年国际本科生项目招生简章
北京航空航天大学 2026 年国际学生本科专业 CSCA 测试科目要求

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport and meet the applicable Chinese nationality-law and Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020) rules.
Have at least a high-school education, be physically and mentally healthy, demonstrate good conduct and goodwill toward China, and normally be 18 to 22 years old.
Complete the online application and all material corrections between November 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026.
Take the CSCA and upload the result to the Beihang application system no later than May 30, 2026.
Register with a personal email address in the Beihang international-student online application system and complete the online form.
Upload the ordinary-passport information page; the passport must remain valid beyond March 1, 2027. Applicants in mainland China must also provide their current visa or residence-permit page.
Upload the high-school diploma; current students may submit an expected-graduation certificate but must provide the formal diploma before final admission and present the original at registration.
Upload transcripts for all high-school courses.
Upload a Foreigner Physical Examination Form and blood-test report completed within six months, in Chinese or English, signed by a physician and stamped by the examining institution.
Upload the financial guarantor letter and evidence of the guarantor's financial capacity, showing either a bank deposit of at least four years' tuition or annual income of at least CNY 30,000.

Upload the applicant's birth certificate and documents proving both parents' nationality status when the applicant was born, including relevant passports, identity cards or permanent-residence records.
Upload a no-criminal-record certificate issued within six months; applicants currently in China must use a certificate from the local entry-exit authority.
Upload the integrity commitment letter; authenticity problems result in immediate cancellation of application eligibility.
Submit a notarized Guardian Guarantee whose guardian is normally an income-earning adult residing in the relevant campus city, Beijing or Hangzhou.
Upload relevant supplementary records such as award certificates, a résumé or a portfolio.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with records not originally in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide notarized translations for every original document not written in Chinese or English.
Provide the required painting portfolio.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 online application fee and upload the payment receipt before formally submitting the application.

references.locator: Section III, step 4 and Section IV

requirements.ruleText: Purchase four academic years of comprehensive medical insurance at registration for a total published fee of CNY 3,200.

Reserve accommodation in advance. Published double-room rates are CNY 30 per bed per day in Beijing and CNY 2,000 to 2,500 per academic year at the Hangzhou International Campus, excluding utilities and subject to actual assignment.

Review the published Chinese Government, Beihang and Beijing scholarship routes. Except for the Chinese Government Scholarship, submit the applicable scholarship materials together with the admission application by the published May 30, 2026 scholarship deadline.
Submit an HSK Level 5 result of at least 180 issued within two years.

requirements.appliesTo: Chinese-taught applicants in this program group
requirements.ruleText: Submit results for Chinese (for Humanities Disciplines), Mathematics; take the subjects in Chinese.

references.locator: Official 2026 CSCA subject table, matching program rows

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled applicants in this program group
requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 25,000 per year.

sources.title: BLCU 2026 International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Regular Programs Guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen.
Be friendly to China, have no criminal record, and comply with Chinese laws, regulations, and university rules.
Be in good physical and mental health and in good academic and behavioral standing.
Intend to work in Chinese-language education, teaching, or related fields.
Be 16 to 35 years old on September 1, 2026. The maximum age is 45 for in-service Chinese-language teachers.
Provide an HSK Level 3 score of at least 180 and an HSKK score.
In principle, applicants who received the same type of scholarship within the previous three years are not eligible.

Apply online through the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship section of the CLEC website, select the recommending institution and BLCU as host institution, submit materials, and track the review result.
Complete the application by October 31, 2026 Beijing Time.
Submit a scanned copy of the passport photo page.
Submit scanned HSK and HSKK score reports that remain within their two-year validity period.
Submit a recommendation letter from the head of the recommending institution.
Submit the highest academic qualification or proof of expected graduation. Applicants using expected-graduation proof must provide the formal qualification before BLCU registration.
Submit proof of employment and an employer recommendation letter. Eligible in-service teachers receive priority under equal conditions.

references.locator: Sections V.1 and VI supplementary item 1

requirements.ruleText: Submit notarized guardian-guarantee documents for a foreign national residing in China or a Chinese resident in Beijing formally entrusted by the applicant's parents.
Do not submit false materials or conceal visa records in the passport; verified misconduct results in scholarship disqualification.
Provide additional materials if requested by BLCU.
Apply for only one scholarship provided by a Chinese government institution; duplicate applications are invalid and may cause disqualification.
Pass the enrollment medical examination and register on time without unauthorized withdrawal or suspension; otherwise the scholarship may be canceled.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid private passport and observe Chinese laws and BUCT regulations.
Hold a master's degree or equivalent with excellent academic standing and be under age 40.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport, demonstrate good conduct, have no criminal record and comply with Chinese laws and ECNU rules.
Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent or higher recognized in China.
Complete the ECNU online application, upload every required document and pay the non-refundable RMB 800 fee. Each application permits one program choice.
Submit a passport information page valid for at least six months after enrollment and attach Chinese visa pages when applicable.

Submit the bachelor's degree certificate and complete undergraduate transcript; pending graduates submit current transcripts and expected-graduation proof and must obtain final certificates by September 1, 2026.
HSK 5 ≥ 210; confirm the current admissions guide for discipline-specific thresholds.

references.locator: Eligibility item 4 and Application Documents item 3

requirements.ruleText: Provide two Chinese- or English-language recommendations from associate professors, professors or related senior professionals, issued after September 1, 2025 with complete recommender identity and contact details.
Submit an English or Chinese personal statement in the route language of at least 1,000 words covering academic background, research experience, interests and goals.
Submit a publication catalogue and abstracts or other original research achievements when applicable.
Upload a recent color ID photograph with a plain background and full-face uncovered head.
Submit applicable award certificates.
Submit the published program-specific supplement: an arts portfolio or music video, the International Chinese Language Education master's essay, or the doctoral work-experience proof, as applicable.
Submit a valid health certificate issued within six months with the required examination and blood-test details.

references.locator: Supplemental Documents for Scholarship Applicants item 1

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid regular foreign passport, be physically and mentally healthy, be friendly to China, and have no criminal record.

Hold a master's degree awarded by an institution accredited by the Chinese Ministry of Education; an expected graduate may use a school-sealed pre-graduation certificate and must obtain the required degree before registration.
Pass HSK Level 6 with at least 210 points, or submit proof that the highest completed education was taught in Chinese for the published exemption.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with relevant former Chinese nationality or Chinese-parentage history
requirements.ruleText: Submit the applicable renunciation, household-registration cancellation, foreign permanent-residence, foreign-nationality-at-birth and Chinese-parent status evidence listed by SDU.

references.locator: Eligibility note and Application Documents item 10

requirements.ruleText: Complete the application by May 31, 2026; supplementary materials are not accepted after the deadline, and the guide recommends completing the application at least two weeks early.
Register and complete the online application in the Shandong University Application System for International Students; hard copies are not required.
Submit the passport personal-information page from a regular passport valid beyond March 1, 2027.
Submit undergraduate and master's diplomas/degrees or the relevant pre-graduation certificate, plus school-sealed transcripts of all undergraduate and master's courses.

Submit two program-related recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or experts with equivalent titles; each must include a handwritten signature, position, institution, telephone number and email address.
Use SDU's template for the motivation letter and write it in Chinese.
Submit a normally two-year-valid language certificate or, where eligible, a responsible-person-signed and school-sealed letter proving the language of instruction.
Submit a complete Foreign Physical Examination Form with photo, cross-page seal, physician signature and official hospital stamp; the result is valid for six months.
Submit a Certificate of No Criminal Record issued by the local public-security management department and valid within six months before application.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants not covered by the scholarship exemption stated for this degree guide
requirements.ruleText: Submit the applicant's or immediate-family guarantor's passport/ID and proof of deposits of at least RMB 50,000 or equivalent foreign currency.
Submit proof of employment and the table of contents and abstracts of published academic articles when available.

Upload Chinese or English documents, or originals with certified Chinese/English translations; use color scans, not phone photos or photocopies, and do not use handwritten documents except the physical-examination form and signatures.
Complete any document review, interview, written test or other assessment requested by SDU; admission is based on the final evaluation.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee after receiving the pre-admission email.
Pay annual tuition of RMB 26,000.
Pay the RMB 800 annual medical-insurance fee; required insurance is necessary to complete registration.
Budget the published accommodation range of RMB 23-45 per person per day according to room type.
Register at the time in the admission letter and present original graduation/degree, language, physical-examination and other required documents; missing originals can disqualify enrollment.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen under age 45.
Hold a bachelor's degree or higher.
Have at least three years of related work experience.
Be a senior public official, manager or university/research scholar from a Belt and Road country within the published target profile.
Demonstrate the ability to undertake professional courses in English.
Apply to SEU by March 15, 2026, obtain pre-admission after review, then complete the CSC Type A application using agency 1563 by March 31, 2026.
Submit a valid passport copy.

Submit the highest degree diploma and complete academic transcripts.
Submit two recommendation letters and an employment or in-service certificate.
Submit the published study or research plan and English-proficiency evidence.
Follow the two-year 1+1 model: year one at SEU, year two thesis work in the home country, followed by return for defense.
This is a full Chinese Government Scholarship route; the official SEU guide does not itemize components or publish a self-financed tuition alternative.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport.
Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical-examination requirements for a Chinese student visa or residence permit.
Hold a master's degree or equivalent.
Have excellent academic performance and good moral character, comply with laws and regulations, and have no school disciplinary, security-penalty or criminal record.
Apply in round one from January 1-February 15, 2026 or round two from February 16-April 30, 2026.
Complete the SYSU online application, upload the required records, download and hand-sign the generated application, commitment and financial-support forms, then upload the signed copies.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee. Qualified applicants undergo SYSU document review and interview; unpaid applications are invalid.

Submit an ordinary passport valid through at least December 1, 2026 and a profile photo; mainland-China residents also submit the current visa/residence-permit page and entry stamp. Former Chinese-area citizens also submit the published nationality-renunciation records.

Submit bachelor's and master's degree certificates, diplomas and the applicable CHSI or CSCSE verification reports; current-year applicants may use pre-graduation proof but must provide the final master's degree before enrollment.
Submit complete, institution-stamped bachelor's and master's transcripts.
Submit HSK Level 5 with at least 180; the published Chinese-medium education exemption may apply after SYSU verification.
Submit two academic recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or equivalent experts in the applicant's field.
Submit a study and research plan of approximately 6,000 words covering academic/professional background, research achievements, doctoral research plan and career plans.

Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form plus the original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory reports, hospital-stamped and issued within six months; qualifying mainland-China residence documents may substitute as published.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months before application.
Optionally submit awards or evidence of relevant experience.
Submit originals in Chinese or English; records in other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations.
Pay the official annual tuition for this route: RMB 34,000/academic year.
Self-funded students arrange housing because dormitory places are limited. Purchase the required comprehensive medical insurance at RMB 800 per academic year.
Use the admission records to obtain an X1 visa, register in person at the stated time and convert the X1 visa to a student residence permit within 30 days of entry.

sources.title: Sun Yat-sen University 2026 Cambodia Aerospace Scholarship Program

requirements.ruleText: Hold nationality of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Hold a bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline.
Have a foundation in electronic information, computer science, communication engineering, aerospace engineering or a related STEM field.

Demonstrate English sufficient for study and daily communication through native-speaker status, IELTS 5.5 or above, a SYSU-accepted equivalent, or proof of prior Chinese- or English-medium instruction.
Be physically and mentally healthy, law-abiding and friendly toward China, with no criminal or prior-school disciplinary record and no condition barring entry or long-term residence in China.
Obtain nomination from the Cambodian Academy of Digital Technology; SYSU conducts document review and interview assessment independently.
Submit to CADT by August 10, 2026 and complete the matching SYSU online application and document submission by August 11, 2026.
Submit the SYSU International Student Application Form generated by the system.
Submit the bachelor's degree and graduation certificates, or expected-graduation proof for final-year students, plus complete official undergraduate transcripts.
Submit the official CADT recommendation letter stating the reasons for recommendation and ranking.
Submit a curriculum vitae in English.
Submit an approximately 1,500-word Chinese or English study plan focused on aerospace information engineering.
Submit IELTS or an equivalent English result, or proof of English-medium instruction under the published alternatives.
Submit a copy of a valid ordinary passport.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form issued within six months, with photograph and hospital seal.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record.
Optionally submit research achievements, awards or other supporting materials.
Submit materials in Chinese or English; other-language records require certified translations.
Pay RMB 80,000 per academic year, calculated over two years; other travel and living costs follow the program agreement, and the route is ineligible for SYSU's international scholarship scheme.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who previously held Chinese citizenship or have a Chinese-citizen parent
requirements.ruleText: Meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020) and submit the published naturalization, renunciation and recent entry/exit evidence where applicable.
Submit a passport copy whose validity extends beyond September 1, 2027.
Submit an uninterrupted study and work experience resume beginning with senior high school and fully disclose prior study in China.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form covering all listed items and completed after September 30, 2026.
Submit a certificate of non-criminal record valid within six months before the application date; qualifying fresh graduates may submit the published school conduct certificate.
Submit the current visa and a good-conduct/performance certificate from the present institution; undergraduate applicants studying at a Chinese university must also submit the withdrawal certificate.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Submit the original document together with a notarized Chinese or English translation.
Tianjin University may request original or notarized hard copies for further qualification checks; false materials result in disqualification.

Complete the TJU online application by May 31, 2027. Scholarship applicants should follow any earlier route-specific deadline; undergraduate scholarship applicants are requested to apply by April 1, 2027.
Pay the published CNY 500 application fee after admission; Chinese Government Scholarship winners are exempt under the stated rule.
Pay CNY 800 per year for accidental-injury and hospitalization insurance.
Budget the published CNY 15-60 per bed per day, depending on campus and room type.
Use the ordinary passport, Admission Notice, JW201/JW202 and original physical-examination records to obtain an X1 visa and register on the dates in the Admission Notice.
Hold a master's degree and be younger than 40.
Submit HSK Level 5 with a score of at least 180; native Chinese speakers and applicants completing the preceding degree in Chinese may use the published exemption.
Submit bachelor's and master's diplomas or the applicable pre-graduation certificate and notarized transcripts; provide final originals before registration.
Submit a Chinese- or English-language research proposal of at least 1,000 words bearing a Tianjin University professor's signature.
Submit two Chinese- or English-language recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.

requirements.ruleText: Upload the Tianjin University supervisor acceptance letter; doctoral research proposals still require the published TJU professor signature.

requirements.ruleText: Submit the published electronic works collection and video presentation.

requirements.appliesTo: Self-sponsored and Peiyang Future Scholar Scholarship applicants
requirements.ruleText: Submit a bank deposit certificate or financial guarantor income certificate.
Pay the official tuition schedule: RMB 38,000/year.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary passport, be in good physical and mental health, have good conduct and comply with Chinese laws and Tianjin University rules.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who previously held Chinese citizenship or have a Chinese-citizen parent
requirements.ruleText: Meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020) and submit the published naturalization, renunciation and recent entry/exit evidence where applicable.
Submit a passport copy whose validity extends beyond September 1, 2027.
Submit an uninterrupted study and work experience resume beginning with senior high school and fully disclose prior study in China.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form covering all listed items and completed after September 30, 2026.
Submit a certificate of non-criminal record valid within six months before the application date; qualifying fresh graduates may submit the published school conduct certificate.
Submit the current visa and a good-conduct/performance certificate from the present institution; undergraduate applicants studying at a Chinese university must also submit the withdrawal certificate.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Submit the original document together with a notarized Chinese or English translation.

Pay the published CNY 500 application fee after admission; Chinese Government Scholarship winners are exempt under the stated rule.
Pay CNY 800 per year for accidental-injury and hospitalization insurance.
Budget the published CNY 15-60 per bed per day, depending on campus and room type.
Use the ordinary passport, Admission Notice, JW201/JW202 and original physical-examination records to obtain an X1 visa and register on the dates in the Admission Notice.
Hold a high-school diploma and be younger than 25; submit a pre-graduation certificate if the diploma is not yet available and provide the final original or notarized diploma before registration.
Submit HSK Level 5 with a score of at least 180; native Chinese speakers and applicants completing high school in Chinese may use the published exemption.

Submit CSCA results for Chinese for Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry. Use the test-paper language matching the program teaching language; English-taught routes do not take Professional Chinese.

HSK 5 with every subscore above 60, or HSK 4 with every subscore above 60 and HSK 5 achieved by the end of the first academic year. A published waiver may apply to native Chinese speakers or applicants educated in Chinese at high school.

Pay the published tuition for this route: RMB 30,000/year.

sources.title: USTC 2026 International Undergraduate Application Guideline

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport and be in good physical and mental health.
Hold a senior-high graduation certificate equivalent to a Chinese high-school diploma by July 2026; a 2026 graduate may apply with a pre-graduation certificate.
Pass New HSK Level 5 or above; a native Chinese speaker or applicant with proof of Chinese-medium high-school study may request the published exemption.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan
requirements.ruleText: Have obtained current foreign citizenship and renounced Chinese nationality before April 30, 2022, and have lived abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022 and April 30, 2026 under the published nine-month rule.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants born abroad with one or two Chinese-citizen parents
requirements.ruleText: Provide qualifying proof of the Chinese parent's foreign permanent residence at the applicant's birth, proof that the applicant renounced Chinese nationality, or the applicant's PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card.
Meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020).
Submit valid CSCA results with the online application: Professional Chinese (STEM) and Mathematics are compulsory, and either Physics or Chemistry must be selected.
Complete the online application from November 14, 2025 through March 31, 2026.
Submit the USTC Application Form for International Students (Undergraduate Program).
Submit a passport copy, including Chinese visa or residence-permit pages when applicable.
Submit notarized senior-high graduation certificate and transcripts; a prospective July 2026 graduate may submit a school-issued pre-graduation certificate and must present originals at registration.
Submit New HSK Level 5 certificate and score report, or qualifying proof of Chinese-medium high-school study; admitted applicants must present the original language records at registration.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Submit an original Chinese- or English-language recommendation letter from the senior high school.
Submit the USTC Guardian Statement; the guardian must stay in Hefei during study and have a stable source of living.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan
requirements.ruleText: Submit the immigration certificate, proof of cancellation of original Chinese citizenship, passport entry/exit-stamp pages and proof of living abroad for the published April 2022-April 2026 period.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants born abroad with one or two Chinese-citizen parents
requirements.ruleText: Submit one of the three published nationality-status documents supporting eligibility.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with SAT, IB, GCE A-Level, ACT or AST results
requirements.ruleText: Optionally submit the score report; it is accepted only within two years of the examination date.
Complete any further test or interview requested after USTC evaluates the CSCA results and application materials.
Pay tuition of CNY 26,000 per academic year.
Pay the published CNY 800 annual insurance fee.
Budget CNY 500-1,000 per month according to room type and size.
Use the ordinary passport, Admission Notice, JW202 and original physical-examination records to obtain an X1 visa and register on the dates stated in the Admission Notice.

sources.title: Xiamen University 2026 International Doctoral Admission Guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen, physically and mentally healthy, friendly to China, and hold a valid regular foreign passport.
Hold a master's degree or above and generally be under 50 years old by September 1, 2026.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants formerly holding Chinese nationality or born abroad to Chinese parents
requirements.ruleText: Meet the guide's nationality-document and overseas-residence rules, including the applicable four-year foreign-passport period and two years of actual overseas residence during the preceding four years.

For Chinese-medium study, humanities, economics, management, law and arts generally require HSK 5 with 210; science, engineering, medicine and physical education generally require HSK 4 with 210. A qualifying prior Chinese-medium education certificate may replace HSK evidence under the guide.
Apply online from December 1, 2025 through May 10, 2026. Scholarship application deadlines are earlier and follow the corresponding scholarship notice.
Register in the XMU international student application system, complete the application, upload the required records and pay the application fee online.
Submit the passport information page valid through at least October 31, 2026, birth certificate, and identity documents of both parents.

Submit bachelor's and master's degree certificates and complete undergraduate and master's transcripts; expected graduates may use official expected-graduation proof but must present the final original master's degree at registration.

For Chinese-medium study, humanities, economics, management, law and arts generally require HSK 5 with 210; science, engineering, medicine and physical education generally require HSK 4 with 210. A qualifying prior Chinese-medium education certificate may replace HSK evidence under the guide.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.
Submit a personal statement and study/research plan of at least 1,000 words in the program's language of instruction.
Submit a curriculum vitae.
A pre-acceptance letter from the proposed XMU academic unit or supervisor is recommended and receives priority consideration where the guide states.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form and attachments, completed as required and valid for six months.
Submit the financial guarantee statement and supporting financial records. Applying for a scholarship does not waive this document.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate issued within six months before application.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to art programs or applicants with academic outputs
requirements.ruleText: Art applicants submit the required portfolio; applicants may also submit publications, awards and other supporting academic evidence.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants whose records are not in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide notarized Chinese or English translations. XMU may request original or supplementary records and materials are not returned.
Undergo XMU's comprehensive qualification review and the admitting unit's academic assessment, which may include a remote interview or written examination.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee.

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled Chinese-medium doctoral students in this route
requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 30,000 or 34,000 according to discipline category. The published guide waives tuition for the fourth academic year.
Purchase comprehensive medical insurance at RMB 800 per year.

Budget for campus-dependent accommodation and living costs: published accommodation ranges include RMB 35-65/day at Siming, RMB 1,600-4,000/year at Xiang'an, and RMB 1,100-1,200/year at Zhangzhou; the guide estimates food at RMB 1,000-1,500/month.

sources.title: Zhejiang Gongshang University International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship 2026 Application Guidelines

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen.
Be friendly to China, have no criminal record, and comply with Chinese laws, regulations, and host-institution rules.
Be in good physical and mental health and in good academic and behavioral standing.
Be interested in Chinese-language education and related work.
Be 18 to 35 years old on September 1, 2026.
Provide an HSK Level 3 score of at least 180 and an HSKK score.
In principle, applicants who received a similar scholarship within the previous three years are not eligible.

Complete applications simultaneously in the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship system and the Zhejiang Gongshang University international-student application system before the deadline.
Complete the online applications by October 31, 2026 Beijing Time.
Submit a scanned copy of the photo page of a valid passport.
Submit scanned HSK and HSKK score reports within their two-year validity period.
Submit a recommendation letter from the person in charge of the recommending institution.
Submit proof of the highest academic degree and academic transcripts.
Submit two two-inch photographs.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form with a result valid within six months.
Submit a power of attorney signed by the guardian in China.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record valid within six months.
Attach an employment certificate and recommendation letter issued by the employing institution, if available.
Submit the remittance receipt for the application fee. The captured official page does not state the fee amount.
Confirm the study-in-China procedures with Zhejiang Gongshang University and register on time according to the admission notice.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen.

Intend to engage in Chinese-language education, teaching, or related work.
Be 18 to 35 years old as of September 1, 2026; in-service Chinese-language teachers may be up to 45.

requirements.appliesTo: One-semester Chinese Language and Literature applicants
requirements.ruleText: Provide an HSK Level 3 score of at least 180 and an HSKK result. The official page does not state a minimum HSKK score for this route.
In principle, applicants who received a similar scholarship within the previous three years are not eligible.
Complete applications in both the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship system and the Zhejiang University international-student application system.
Complete the online applications by October 31, 2026. The official page does not state a cutoff time.
Submit a scanned copy of the passport photo page; the passport must remain valid through March 1, 2027 or later.
Submit scanned HSK and HSKK score reports that remain within their two-year validity period.
Submit a recommendation letter from the person responsible for the recommending institution.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants submitting documents in a language other than Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide notarized translations for application materials not written in Chinese or English.
Upload materials through the application systems; materials mailed on paper or sent by email will not be reviewed.
An employment certificate and recommendation letter from the employing institution may be provided and receive priority under otherwise equal conditions.
Apply in the scholarship system using the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship certificate.
Scholarship eligibility may be cancelled for a failed entry medical examination, withdrawal, failure to register on time without permission, or suspension of study.

requirements.ruleText: Provide HSK Level 3 with at least 180 and an HSKK score report, both within their two-year validity period.

requirements.ruleText: Provide an HSK score report; applicants who also provide HSKK receive priority.

requirements.ruleText: In principle, applicants who received a similar scholarship within the previous three years are not eligible.
Upload a scanned copy of the passport photo page.
Submit the highest diploma or expected-graduation proof and an official transcript.
Submit proof of employment and a reference letter from the employer; under equal conditions, applicants providing both receive admission priority.
Submit certified designation documents signed by the entrusted legal guardian in China.
Submit a physical-examination form issued within six months.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate issued within six months.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with prior study experience in China
requirements.ruleText: Submit an institution-stamped certificate of academic performance from the period of study in China.
Apply in the ZJUT system from September 1, 2026 and complete the ZJUT application by October 20, 2026.

Select the International Chinese Language Teacher Scholarship Program category in the ZJUT system. After ZJUT review and issuance of its recommendation letter, submit the materials and recommendation through the CIS scholarship platform before the deadline.
Use the CIS application website to follow application progress, review comments and scholarship evaluation results.
Monitor the submitted email address for the final admission result.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants holding an International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Certificate from a Chinese Bridge competition
requirements.ruleText: Submit the application documents together with the scholarship certificate directly to the host institution through the scholarship website.
Ensure all application materials are authentic and valid; otherwise admission will be cancelled.

Pass the pre-enrollment physical examination, register at the university as required, do not withdraw before completing study, and do not take unauthorized leave; otherwise scholarship eligibility is cancelled.
Obtain university approval before living off campus; approved students receive the published RMB 700 monthly accommodation allowance.
Purchase the required comprehensive medical insurance first; the premium is refunded to the student's bank card after registration and check-in are completed.
